title: Two-factor authentication
description: An extra code from your authenticator app on every sign-in.

backupWarning.title: Add a second app
backupWarning.body: There are no recovery codes. If you lose this authenticator, only an administrator can get you back in — a second app is your way out.

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app.
setup.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:

removeDialog.title: Remove two-factor authentication
removeDialog.body: Enter a current code from “{{name}}” to confirm it's you. Removing it makes your account less safe.
removeDialog.lastFactor: This is your only authenticator. Removing it turns two-factor authentication off.

challenge.title: Enter your code
challenge.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the code from “{{name}}”.

error.invalidCode: That code isn't right. Check the app and try again.
error.expiredChallenge: That code expired. Enter the current one.
error.factorLimit: You've reached the maximum number of authenticator apps.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.totpDisabled: Two-factor authentication isn't available right now.
